title: Preview files to be deleted by BleachBit
summary: Use BleachBit to see which junk files will be removed before actually deleting them. This helps you avoid accidentally deleting important data.

steps.explain: List available cleaner options to find the names you need for the preset.
steps.expect: A list of cleaner names and their options.

steps.explain: Preview the files that will be deleted for specific cleaners without actually deleting them.

placeholders.name: CLEANER_OPTIONS
placeholders.description: Space-separated list of cleaner options, e.g., 'firefox.cache firefox.cookies'

steps.expect: A list of files and changes that would be made.
